My visual data story

Social media posts as observations

This visual data story explores social media posts I observed and logged using a Google Form. Each row represents one post that appeared during observation.

What kinds of posts appeared most often?

Bar chart showing the number of observed posts for each type of social media content.

This chart shows the main types of posts that appeared in my observations.

When were posts observed?

Line graph showing the number of posts observed by hour of the day.

This plot uses the timestamp from the Google Form to show when observations were recorded.

Did different content types lead to different engagement?

Grouped bar chart showing engagement types for different social media content categories.

This chart compares content type with engagement type.

What does the data suggest?

Overall, the visual story suggests that social media feeds can be analysed through repeated observations. Looking at content type, engagement, and viewing time together gives a clearer picture of what kinds of posts appeared and how I responded to them.
